text: You paid for dinner. Now comes the awkward part: getting paid back.
In Duitful, add your friends and split the bill equally, or by what each person had.
Send everyone their share in one message. Each friend gets their own link.
They don't need the app. The link shows what they owe, and where to transfer.
When they've sent the money, they tap: I've paid.
You check your bank, then confirm. Nothing is settled until you say so.
Duitful shows who has paid, and who still owes you.
Lent a friend money? Record it the same way, with a date to remind you.
Everything owed to you sits in one list, apart from your own debts.
Duitful. Split bills, and get paid back. Free on the App Store and Google Play.
